name: ilang
description: iLang, the native language of AI: the official runtime, the canon validator, dictionary and FAQ lookup, SOUL 2.0 and Source Book 2.9, from ilang.ai/mcp.

interface.shortDescription: The native language of AI: runtime, validator, SOUL and Source Book as tools
interface.longDescription: Gives the model the official iLang: the runtime it loads once per conversation (verified against the canon's sha256), the full text for any section the runtime leaves out, the canon grammar validator in strict mode, lookup over the dictionary and the ilang.ai FAQ, and the two published iLang documents, SOUL 2.0 and Source Book 2.9, as files with version, DOI and sha256. Give it a tutorial and it writes BOOK.md, an executable iLang engineering book, checked by the same validator. Read-only, no key, nothing stored.
defaultPrompt: Load the iLang runtime, then write an iLang engineering book from this tutorial and check it
